ambientRatingRule.source: overhead ratings at 0 °C air: the design rating × 874/634 (VDE FNN Hinweis WAFB 1.0 Table 1, 243-AL1/39-ST1A, Cigre TB 601, 0.6 m/s, 900 W/m², 80 °C conductor; I² linear in air temperature between 20 °C 749 A and −10 °C 930 A); Statnett rates lines per air temperature (SDOK-39-30 rev 6.0). The winter reference hour (2026-01-12 07:00 UTC) had −15 to −3 °C at the eastern and northern load centres and +0.6 to +1.2 °C on the west coast, in darkness (ERA5 via Open-Meteo). The summer reference hour (2026-07-12 04:00 UTC) had 9.5–18 °C (ERA5); its Operating Point derates overhead lines to their 20 °C rating (× 749/874). Cable ratings do not follow air temperature.

emergencyRule.source: short-term limit typically 20 % above continuous for 15 min (Statnett SDOK-39-30 rev 6.0, thermal limits of overhead lines)

transformerRule.source: rating: the smaller of the high-voltage line capacity and the low-voltage line capacity (lines at their 35 °C design rating) plus the larger of generation and load on the low-voltage bus (what that bus passes on), at least 1.25 × that local injection, rounded up to 50 MVA; x 0.12 pu on rating (FD1 guidance 0.10–0.15), X/R 40; tap ratio 1

shuntRule.source: reactor absorbs 70 % of half the 1-pu charging of every connected ≥300 kV line and cable; typical shunt compensation degrees are 60–80 % (IPST 2005, paper 05IPST109)
